bytes.description: A `Tensor` of type `string`. Tensor of serialized protos with shape `batch_shape`.

message_type.description: A `string`. Name of the proto message type to decode.

field_names.description: A list of `strings`. List of strings containing proto field names. An extension field can be decoded by using its full name, e.g. EXT_PACKAGE.EXT_FIELD_NAME.

output_types.description: A list of `tf.DTypes`. List of TF types to use for the respective field in field_names.

descriptor_source.description: An optional `string`. Defaults to `"local://"`. Either the special value `local://` or a path to a file containing a serialized `FileDescriptorSet`.
constraints: descriptor_source must be one of string, FileDescriptorSet

message_format.description: An optional `string`. Defaults to `"binary"`. Either `binary` or `text`.
constraints: message_format must be one of string, binary, text

sanitize.description: An optional `bool`. Defaults to `False`. Whether to sanitize the result or not.

output.description: A tuple of `Tensor` objects (sizes, values). A `Tensor` of type `int32`. values: A list of `Tensor` objects of type `output_types`.
